## Appearance

Hester Gray is described as a small girl with soft eyes. She has dark hair that is easily ruffled by the wind.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P40](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0040)_

## History

Hester Gray died at the age of twenty-two, thirty years prior to the events of the story. She is buried beneath a small brown headstone carved with an image of opening gates. Her grave's inscription reads: "Sacred to the memory of Hester Gray, aged twenty-two."

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049)_
